hotel_name: The St. Regis Macao, Cotai Central

claims.text: The hotel's address is The Londoner Macao, Estrada do Istmo, in Cotai, Macau.

findings.quote: The Londoner Macao, Estrada do Istmo s/n, Cotai, Macau, China

claims.text: The hotel is on the Cotai Strip, in an entertainment and shopping center with more than 850 luxury stores.

findings.quote: A luxury address on the Cotai Strip
is a center for entertainment and shopping that boasts more than 850 luxury stores and an array of dining options

claims.text: Macau International Airport is about 3 kilometers from the hotel.

findings.quote: MFM is located approximately 3.0 KM from the hotel.

claims.text: The St. Regis Butler service is available to all hotel guests.

findings.quote: The St. Regis signature Butler service is available to all hotel guests

claims.text: Marble bathrooms have a double-basin vanity, a separate shower and soaking bathtub, and a mirror-embedded LCD television.

findings.quote: The marble bathroom invites indulgence with a double-basin vanity, separate shower and soaking bathtub, as well as a mirror-embedded LCD television.

claims.text: The Manor, the hotel's signature restaurant, serves Mediterranean dining with artisanal seafood and crafted cocktails.

findings.quote: Our signature restaurant, The Manor, showcases
The Manor elevates Mediterranean dining with artisanal seafood and crafted cocktails

claims.text: The St. Regis Bar serves artisan cocktails and chef-crafted menus in a setting inspired by the House of Astor.

findings.quote: offering artisan cocktails and chef-crafted menus in a contemporary setting inspired by the House of Astor

claims.text: The Pavilion offers casual alfresco dining with family-friendly fare beside the outdoor pool.

findings.quote: Ideal for casual alfresco dining on the Cotai Strip in Macau, The Pavilion offers refreshing beverages and family-friendly fare beside the outdoor pool.

claims.text: The outdoor pool is on the eighth floor, with an all-day menu and full beverage service.

findings.quote: features an outdoor pool on the eighth floor with an all-day menu and full beverage service

claims.text: The concierge team can coordinate reservations for ferry cruises and helicopter tours.

findings.quote: our Concierge team is available to coordinate reservations for ferry cruises and helicopter tours

claims.text: Guests can join a mixologist at The St. Regis Bar to mix their own Bloody Mary cocktails.

findings.quote: join our mixologist and mix your own Bloody Mary cocktails
Our Cotai Strip, Macau hotel is proud to offer and present the Art of Drinking experiences at The St. Regis Bar.

claims.text: The hotel is a Forbes Travel Guide 2026 Five-Star Hotel.

findings.quote: Forbes Travel Guide 2026 – Five-Star Hotel

claims.text: The hotel's signature cocktail, Maria do Leste, is its take on the Bloody Mary, inspired by the voyages of Portuguese sailors.

findings.quote: The St. Regis Macao Signature Cocktail, Maria do Leste, takes inspiration from the worldly voyages of the Portuguese sailors
for a unique interpretation of the traditional Bloody Mary

claims.text: A candy workshop features Yau Kei's Dragon's Beard Candy, demonstrated by second-generation master Kenny Yuen.

findings.quote: a delightful candy workshop featuring Yau Kei’s Dragon’s Beard Candy
Join us as Kenny Yuen, the second-generation master, demonstrates this intangible Cultural Heritage

claims.text: Rooms and suites are fitted with traditional Chinese elements and have marble bathrooms with products from SACHAJUAN, Sodashi and REN.

findings.quote: luxury hotel rooms or suites fitted with traditional Chinese elements, each boasting dramatic views and marble bathrooms with a bespoke amenity collection featuring best-in-class product lines from SACHAJUAN, Sodashi and REN skincare

claims.text: The St. Regis Athletic Club is on the eighth floor, with floor-to-ceiling views of the Cotai Strip.

findings.quote: ## The St. Regis Athletic Club
Located on the eighth floor, it boasts floor-to-ceiling views of the inspiring Cotai Strip.

claims.text: In a small-group cooking class, the hotel's chefs teach guests to make two signature dishes from The Manor.

findings.quote: our expert chefs will guide and teach you in a small group the fundamentals of crafting two signature dishes from The Manor

claims.text: The hotel does not have an airport shuttle to Macau International Airport.

findings.quote: No, The St. Regis Macao does not have an airport shuttle to Macau International Airport.

claims.text: Children 1.4 meters tall and under must wear arm bands or life vests in the pool area; the hotel provides them free of charge.

findings.quote: All children 1.4 meters in height and under are required to wear inflatable arm bands or life vests when using hotel swimming facilities. Both are provided on a complimentary basis by the hotel.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the busy casino resort environment may not suit all travelers.
